channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Announcing Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic with improved reasoning for voice agents
item.description: Today, we announce the general availability of Amazon Nova 2.5 Sonic, our latest speech-to-speech model for natural, real-time voice agents. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Cloudflare Open Sources Decision Models for AI Agents
item.description: During its recent “Birthday Week”, Cloudflare announced Clef, a set of open-weight AI models designed to choose between predefined options rather than generate text. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Config now supports 77 new resource types
item.description: AWS Config now supports 77 additional AWS resource types across key services including Amazon EC2, Amazon S3 Files, and Amazon Q Business. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Advanced Ruby Driver Wrapper is generally available
item.description: The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Advanced Ruby Driver Wrapper is now generally available for use with Amazon RDS and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and MySQL-compatible databases. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Batch now supports Amazon EKS access entry authentication
item.description: AWS Batch now supports Amazon EKS access entry authentication for compute environments. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Private CA now provides detailed certificate issuance logs
item.description: AWS Private CA announces detailed certificate issuance logs, a new AWS CloudTrail service event that records the complete certificate content, issuing CA information, requester identity, and signing status for every issuance. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service introduces validation advisory for domain configuration changes
item.description: Amazon OpenSearch Service now provides validation advisory for domain configuration changes, which helps you make informed decisions about changes that carry risk but can still be applied. (1 source: aws)
